tone: Warm, creative, light energy; smiles on the occasion examples, steady on the rules line.
script: Hi, I'm an AI presenter, and this is SongScribe AI. Some moments deserve more than a card. SongScribe turns your story into an original song, with music, lyrics and vocals, built from a guided brief. Tell its AI Producer about a birthday, a wedding or someone you miss, by chat or by voice. It shows the cost before spending credits, then returns two variations, typically in thirty to sixty seconds. Creators use it for intros and theme music. Brands use it for jingles, sonic logos and campaign soundtracks. Genres run from acoustic and gospel to Afrobeat and Amapiano, and lyrics can blend English, pidgin and Yoruba. The rules are clear: no copyrighted lyrics or melodies, and no artist sound-alikes. Start free, then choose a personal or commercial licence. Your story, turned into a song.
